description: Mark every unread received message in a conversation as read (the user's dashboard badge clears at once). Reading a thread with get_conversation_history does NOT mark it read — only call this when the user asks to mark something read. If the user enabled "Mark read on Mac" in autoMessage, their Mac also opens the thread in Messages.app so the read receipt is sent over iMessage; the result's `macSync` is "requested" or "off". Returns { conversationId, markedRead, unreadCount, macSync }.
name: mark_conversation_read
